description: IQM Sirius boasts a star topology processor with 16 qubits all connected to one central computational resonator. In addition to single qubit rotations, all qubits can perform CZ gates with the subspace formed by the two lowest energy levels of the resonator. Furthermore, the novel MOVE operation is calibrated to exchange the occupations of the qubit-resonator states 0-1 and 1-0. It can therefore be used to shuttle excitations back and forth between any qubit and the resonator.
